api_schema: Julia PolicyGraph and JuMP model API; modeler supplies nodes, state variables, uncertainty and objective.

options_defaults_diagnostics: train accepts iteration_limit, time_limit, stopping_rules, log_frequency, log_every_seconds and print_level. Source defaults log frequency to 1 and adds SimulationStoppingRule when no explicit stop rule is supplied.
termination_status, logs, numerical-stability reporting and JuMP solver termination failures are exposed.

integrations_performance: Julia >=1.6; direct dependencies include JuMP, HTTP, JSON, TimerOutputs and standard libraries. Parallel schemes are supported; no normalized performance benchmark extracted.

missingness: No direct VOI measure/report, input interchange schema, accessibility conformance, or cross-solver benchmark was extracted.

api_schema: Abstract POMDP{S,A,O} and MDP{S,A}; model functions include discount, transition and observation. Generative models return NamedTuples.
Solver/Policy/solve/action and Updater/belief interfaces separate offline and online work.
algorithms_features: Typed interfaces for discrete/continuous MDP/POMDP modeling, belief updates, simulation-facing generation and solver interoperability; no algorithm is implemented by the interface package itself.
options_defaults_diagnostics: Default currentobs is available when a belief implements history. Type-inference helpers raise explanatory errors for non-(PO)MDP types.
outputs_examples_tests: solve convention returns a Policy; action executes a policy. Tagged source contains documentation and a Julia Test target.
integrations_performance: Julia >=1.6; dependencies include Distributions, Graphs, NamedTupleTools and POMDPLinter. POMDPTools is referenced for supporting tools. No performance result extracted.
rights_maintenance: MIT; public tagged source. This version tag is from 2024, so current maintenance cannot be inferred solely from it.

records.reason: It is a public, MIT-licensed research application for adaptive informative path planning with multimodal sensing, but is not release-tagged or package-managed, lacks a lockfile/test suite and has stale default-branch activity. It should not enter the maintained software inventory without an explicit application/reproducibility policy; it is not a general VOI estimator.
